subject: Intro + quick qual: Meridn Commerce demo & load patterns
body:
From: Oliver Chen <oliver@meridiancommerce.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridiancommerce.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick intro — looking at Redwood for inference at checkout

Hi Stephanie,

We signed up for the self-serve flow and poked around the hosted API — looks promising. We’re Meridian Commerce (checkout + recommendations for several mid-market merchants). I’m Oliver (Product), looping in Priya (SRE) — we’d like a quick run-through of how Redwood would fit into our checkout scoring pipeline and what to expect for throughput and latency.

High level:
- Use case: scoring checkout-cart fraud/intent and generating personalized microsnippets in the order confirmation flow.
- Typical QPS: currently ~150 qps during peak for our largest merchant, baseline ~20 qps.
- Typical request: short prompt (~40 tokens in, ~80 tokens out).
- Timeline: aiming for a pilot in Q1 2027, production by end of Q1 if performance matches.

Can we book a 30–40 minute demo next week? Also happy to send a volume sample/traffic snapshot if that helps.

Thanks — Oliver
Meridian Commerce — Product

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@meridiancommerce.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridiancommerce.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — looking at Redwood for inference at checkout

Hi Oliver — great to meet you and thanks for the context. Ben (SDR) is cc’d to coordinate calendar, and Connor (ops) will join the demo for any infra/SRE questions — I’ll loop him in once the time is locked.

A few quick clarifying Qs so we tailor the demo: could you confirm these items?
1) Traffic shape: is the 150 qps sustained for an hour or a short spike (minutes)?
2) Dayparts: is peak during a predictable window (e.g., 5–8pm PT) or distributed?
3) SLA sensitivity: do you need p50/p95 latency targets under X ms, or is cost a stronger constraint for the pilot?
4) Data residency / private deployment needs — are you okay with hosted for pilot or do you need private/Dedicated from day 1?

If you can attach a small sample (meridian_traffic_snapshot.csv) with timestamped qps and avg prompt/response token sizes that helps.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Mon 12/7 10:00–10:40
- Tue 12/8 14:00–14:40
- Wed 12/9 08:30–09:10

If none work, tell us a couple windows and Ben will match.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
From: Oliver Chen <oliver@meridiancommerce.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridiancommerce.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 07:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — looking at Redwood for inference at checkout

Thanks Stephanie — attached is a small sample (meridian_traffic_snapshot.csv) — note we average 20 qps outside peak, the 150 qps is a ~25–30 minute peak during mid-evening. Prompts are very small, tokens as noted. We’re okay starting with Hosted for a short pilot; we’ll evaluate Dedicated if we need stronger tenancy or consistent tail latency.

Also: Priya asked if an SRE could be present to ask questions about logs, KV cache behavior, and rollout strategies. Priya will join if we can calendar a slot in PT morning (she’s east coast).

Oliver

Attachment: meridian_traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@meridiancommerce.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridiancommerce.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 08:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — looking at Redwood for inference at checkout

Appreciate the sample, Oliver. Quick note on slots — Priya on east coast prefers morning PT, so I can propose:
- Tue 12/8 09:00–09:40 PT
- Wed 12/9 09:30–10:10 PT

Which works for you? I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda if you confirm: 1) overview of runtime & latency profiles, 2) caching & batching (KV cache questions), 3) pilot plan & success criteria.

Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference

---
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridiancommerce.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — looking at Redwood for inference at checkout

Ben — Wed 12/9 09:30 PT works best for me. A couple SRE asks for the demo:
- What logging/trace detail is available per-request? (token-level timing, model variant used)
- Can we see a sample of cache hit rates & how prefix caching would behave on short prompts?
- How do you handle fallback on capacity constraints?

I’ll be the technical point on our side; Oliver will handle product questions.

Thanks — Priya
SRE, Meridian Commerce

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@meridiancommerce.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro — looking at Redwood for inference at checkout

Hi Priya — Connor here (runtime/ops). I’ll prepare a short infra section for the demo covering: request tracing, per-route logs, KV cache mechanics for short prompts, and fallback policies (model variants & Dedicated fallback).

Notes for the meeting: please reply with any JIRA/PRD links you want us to look at ahead of time. I’ve attached a short asklist (prod-architecture-asklist.pdf) on typical artifacts that help accelerate pilot readiness.

Attachment: prod-architecture-asklist.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

See you on 2026-12-09 09:30 PT — Ben will send the invite.

Connor O'Brien
Runtime & Operations, Redwood Inference
